author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Five edits outside 'values and remote calls' that the integrator should expect in the merge of wf7/stdlib.

1. strip_resource_noops/resource_noop? (elixir/to_lean.exs, 'external resources' section). Added one clause:
     defp resource_noop?(_mod, e) when is_tuple(e) and tuple_size(e) == 3, do: remote_noop?(e)
   placed immediately before the existing catch-all. This is how every Logger call disappears (the @remote :noop rows), including inside init/1, and it is why a Logger argument never has to be translated. Keep both clauses in that order.

2. hide_unused_parts/3 (render_clauses). It used to hide only the parts of a __whole__ state variable; it now also hides any other pattern variable of the state that the rendered right-hand side does not mention. Needed because a clause whose only use of its state variable was a dropped Logger call would otherwise trip Lean's unused-variable linter, which check.sh treats as a failure. The '_'-prefix test moved from the comprehension into the reduce. No existing output changed (ten Gen files and 49 expectations byte-identical).

3. pat/5. Two changes: a new clause for a binary pattern (a Lean string literal pattern, rejected at a non-String position), and the atom clause now renders an atom at type Atom through atom_ctor/1 (which registers the key in the file's Atom inductive) before falling back to the enum reading. enum_type?/1 also excludes "String" so a string literal pattern never counts towards coverage.

4. expr/3, the binary-operator clause. It now fails with a message when either operand has type Instant and the operator is one of + - < > <= >=: the model has no clock, and the refusal should name that rather than surface as a missing Lean instance.

5. type_of/2 for . The struct branch used to return nil when the variable is not a struct; it now falls back to var_type/2, which knows the type of a record-state field. This is what makes  usable as a case scrutinee on a record state. Strictly a widening: it only turns nil into a type.
title: cross-area edit: resource_noop?/2, hide_unused_parts/3, pat/5 atom+string clauses, expr/3 operator clause, type_of/2 field clause
